mn.help.badgeSize: How big the class badge appears on screen. Drag right to make it bigger.
mn.help.maxPlayers: How many of the nearest players get a nameplate. Lower it if you see FPS drops in crowded places.
mn.help.nameSize: How big the player name appears on screen. Drag right to make it bigger.
mn.help.showFriend: A small heart before the names of your friends.
mn.help.showGuild: A small shield before the names of your guildmates.
mn.help.showIcon: A class-coloured icon above each player, so you can see their class at a glance. It turns grey when the player is dead.
mn.help.showName: The player's name under the badge. Party members are shown in cyan, and the name turns red when the player is dead.
mn.help.showReviveSealed: After a revive skill or Imagine brings someone back, they can't be revived that way again for a while. If they die during that time, their badge and name turn purple with the seconds left, like "Player (42s)".
mn.title: Nameplates
